Jules (CS): Heads-up — HarrowAI wants to roll out to two new squads next quarter: "SearchOps" and "Recommendations". They called out session-scoped embeddings, realtime scoring, and heavy nightly ingest. Asking for ops checklist and sizing.
Ben (AM): Nice upsell motion. Do we have peak qps estimates? helps decide Dedicated vs hosted.
Jules (CS): Their preliminary numbers: SearchOps ~380 rps peak, Recs ~210 rps, nightly embedding ~180k docs. They also want p95 < 150ms.
Sofia (Eng): 380 rps + tight p95 suggests Dedicated pilot unless caching gets them under target. Recommend: prefix KV cache, prefill before cutover, autoscale min 2 max 8. Quick sketch: search 380 rps, recs 210 rps, batch 180k docs/night, SLO p95 <150ms.
Miran (Solutions): We'll map model options: high-quality variant for Recommendations (rdx-4-ptq) and faster embed model for Search (rdx-embed-small-quant). Propose canary split 5-10% with observability checks (latency, 5xx, cost delta).
Jules (CS): Action: one-pager w/ config + month-1 cost delta and a short onboarding playbook. @Ben you own pricing; @Sofia can you draft the runbook snippet?
Ben (AM): On it. I'll include payg vs 3mo commit and include an ops discount if they take Dedicated pilot. I'll also flag renewal messaging since expansion looks like upsell.
Sofia (Eng): Draft config to share:
```yaml
deployment: staged
model_routes:
  - search_fast: rdx-embed-small-quant
  - recs_quality: rdx-4-ptq
batching: adaptive
kv_cache: prefix + session_id
autoscale: min:2, max:8
canary: split 10%, ramp 24h, checks: latency, errors, token-cost-delta
```
Miran (Solutions): I'll prepare a small traffic generator and an eval set to monitor regressions. Also note embedding batching windows to avoid overlap with peak.
notif-bot: ticket created "harrowai-squad-rollout" assigned to @Ben @Sofia @Miran due_in: 3 business days.
Ben (AM): Any renewal risks? Current usage is steady; this is an upsell. Watch for cost pushback during pricing review.
Jules (CS): No churn signals. Main risks: tail latency and batch/peak interference. We'll include Optimize team's recommendations (prefix caching, KV TTL tuning, quantization tradeoffs).
Sofia (Eng): Technical note: recommend warmup traffic 24-48h and run a dry canary with synthetic traffic to validate p95. Also advise session-length KV buckets to keep cache compact.
Jules (CS): I'll schedule the kickoff and share the one-pager by EOD tomorrow. Drop any blockers here. Thanks team :sparkles:
